data.name: Abteen
data.gender_notes: Abteen is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, 'Abteen' refers to a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for his unwavering faith and strength. The name is derived from 'Abt Al-Sama' meaning 'Father of the Sky' or 'Father of the Mountain', symbolizing his connection to the divine and unyielding nature. The name Abteen carries the meaning “Father of the Mountain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abteen usually hope their child will grow to embody father of the mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Abteen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of the Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abteen total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
